Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 10
, Reason for Mistake: The agent incorrectly claimed that Wikipedia confirmed the birthplace of Fernando Cortés as Mexico City, Mexico, likely confusing his place of death with his birthplace. The query itself was malformed (encoding error “Cort%00e9s”) and returned no results, yet the agent still asserted a confirmation. The correct birthplace, per Wikipedia and other sources, is San Juan, Puerto Rico.
